annotations.title: Get request or quote form link

description: Use this when a product is booked by request (most multi-day trips, private or custom dates) or the traveler wants a quote. Returns the See Sight Tours request form link; the traveler enters contact details and consent there. No payment is taken.

id.description: Product id from search_products, e.g. 'tour:<uuid>' or 'trip:<slug>'.

locale.description: Site language for links, e.g. 'en' (default) or 'es'.

name: get_quote_link
title: Get request or quote form link
